text:
sam: quick UX sync  rolled a trimmed roles matrix update to the org settings proto: https://www.figma.com/file/NEW999. Need quick microcopy + a11y pass before we ship. Main asks: role metadata contrast, invite chip copy, and SSO toggle location.

lee: saw it; role metadata at 11px fails AA. Suggest bump to 13px or use --text-muted-strong (#2f2f2f).

ana: SSO toggle currently in the list of security toggles; propose moving to header as a primary action: label options: "Require SSO for organization" / "Enforce single sign-on". Prefer first.

vic: invite chip copy: replace "invited" with "Pending 1 days" when expiration available. Also make the chip focusable and add aria-describedby="invite-desc".

design-bot: auto-scan: 2 contrast failures, 1 missing aria on invite chip, 1 focus-order issue in grid. Auto-PR created: /a11y/1835001111.

sam: prioritise contrast token swap and aria on invite chip. @lee can you drop the token diff? @vic please add the invite string format for translation.

lee: will push token change and screenshot by EOD.

vic: invite string format: "Pending - expires in {n} days" and fallback "Pending". Added to i18n doc.

sam: great, small patch this sprint then copy A/B for SSO next week. Thanks :thumbsup:
_meta: short product thread: roles matrix, invite copy, SSO placement, accessibility fixes
